summary: Retest of the updated Datenschutzerklärung (red warning boxes and BITTE-markers removed, controller stays without home address). Re-ran prior browser checks by name; 2 of them (controller-no-address, tech-services-storage) failed because they asserted on testids/text (privacy-controller-address-note, privacy-technical-missing BITTE PRÜFEN) that were intentionally removed from the page per the new spec. Updated those 2 checks to match the new content and added 1 new check for the 'no red boxes / no BITTE text' criterion. All 8 criteria now verified: 7 browser checks pass plus 1 code/route check for the profile privacy link (no test account available).
